introduction:
Introduction About CIPMIDO TABLET

CIPMIDO TABLET contains Midodrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha -1 Selective Adrenergic Receptor Agonist. It is used to manage low blood pressure (hypotension) in adults. Symptoms of low blood pressure include blurred or fading vision, dizziness or light-headedness, fainting, feeling sick, difficult in concentrating.

Midodrine acts on the blood vessels via the sympathetic nervous system (part of nervous system that cause increase in heart rate, blood pressure, breathing rate, and dilatation of pupil) to correct imbalances of blood distribution, such as preventing too much blood pooling in the legs when standing up which may cause low blood pressure. Your doctor may regularly monitor the blood pressure when you are lying down and when you are standing up as there may be a risk of your blood pressure rising when you lie down (Ex. at night).

CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart disease.CIPMIDO TABLET should be used with caution in patient having severe kidney disease, liver problems. Consult your doctor for advice before takingCIPMIDO TABLET, if you are pregnant or breast-feeding.CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of takingCIPMIDO TABLET are increased blood pressure when lying down, headache, nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, heartburn. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

warnings.details: CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant. Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.
CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding. Discuss with your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or lightheaded after takingCIPMIDO TABLET. Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.
CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.
CIPMIDO TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver impairment. Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.
CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Midodrine.

CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease including slow pulse, heart attack, heart failure, heart rhythm disorders, widening of the aorta (aortic aneurysm) or other cardiovascular diseases and also in patients with high blood pressure, or a form of low blood pressure known as vasovagal hypotension. Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.
CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.

CIPMIDO TABLET is used with caution in patients above 60 years of age. Usually the management is initiated with the lowest dose and gradually increased depending upon the clinical condition of the patient. Consult your doctor before takingCIPMIDO TABLET.

Others

CIPMIDO TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Difficulty in urinating
Have elevated pressure in the eye (glaucoma) or poor vision because of diabetes
Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)
Hormonal disorders caused by a tumour in the adrenal medulla (pheochromocytoma)
Enlarged prostate

Before takingCIPMIDO TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Serious disorder of the nervous system (autonomic nervous system disorders)
Problems with blood circulation
Disease of the prostate

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Reserpine and guanethidine (medicines used to reduce high blood pressure)
Antihistamines like cetirizine, chlorpheniramine (used to manage allergies)
Hormones for the thyroid like thyroxine
Tricyclic antidepressants like clomipramine, amoxapine, amitriptyline and MAO-inhibitors such as selegiline, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, (both used to manage depression)
Vasoconstrictors like epinephrine, dopamine, phenyl epinephrine (medicines that narrow blood vessels)
Sympathomimetic agents such as ephedrine, isoproterenol, metaproterenol, (medicines that have a stimulating effect on certain parts of the nervous system)
Prazosin and phentolamine (medicines used to manage heart disease
Digitalis preparations such as digitoxin, digoxin (medicines used to manage heart disease)
Fludrocortisone acetate (medicine used to reduce inflammation)
Perphenazine (medicine used to manage mental or mood disorders)
Amiodarone (medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Metoclopramide (medicine used to prevent vomiting)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much ofCIPMIDO TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The most common symptoms of overdose are high blood pressure (hypertension), slow heart rate (bradycardia), difficulty urinating and feeling of coldness.

XIDORIN TABLET contains Midodrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha -1 Selective Adrenergic Receptor Agonist. It is used to manage low blood pressure (hypotension) in adults. Symptoms of low blood pressure include blurred or fading vision, dizziness or light-headedness, fainting, feeling sick, difficult in concentrating.

Midodrine acts on the blood vessels via the sympathetic nervous system (part of nervous system that cause increase in heart rate, blood pressure, breathing rate, and dilatation of pupil) to correct imbalances of blood distribution, such as preventing too much blood pooling in the legs when standing up which may cause low blood pressure. Your doctor may regularly monitor the blood pressure when you are lying down and when you are standing up as there may be a risk of your blood pressure rising when you lie down (Ex. at night).

XIDORIN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart disease.XIDORIN TABLET should be used with caution in patient having severe kidney disease, liver problems. Consult your doctor for advice before takingXIDORIN TABLET, if you are pregnant or breast-feeding.XIDORIN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of takingXIDORIN TABLET are increased blood pressure when lying down, headache, nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, heartburn. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

The most common side effects of takingACTIFUL TABLET are increased blood pressure when lying down, headache, nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, heartburn. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Introduction About ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION

ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION contains Noradrenaline which belongs to the group of medicines called Adrenergic and Dopaminergic agents. It is used in emergency conditions to increase blood pressure to normal levels in adults. During ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION management, your doctor will monitor your blood pressure, blood volume, heart rate and the infusion site.

ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with low blood pressure caused by low blood volume. ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver, heart or kidney disease, blood clots, diabetes or over active thyroid gland.

ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION will be given in pregnancy only if clearly necessary as it may cause harm to unborn baby. It is not known whether ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION pass through the breast milk so it should be used with caution.

The safety and efficacy of ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION in children and adolescents under 18 years of age is not established so, contact your child’s doctor for advice. The most common side effects of ADRENOR 4MG INJECTION are low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, anxiety, headache, etc. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About JOLAVI TABLET

JOLAVI TABLET contains Midodrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha -1 Selective Adrenergic Receptor Agonist. It is used to manage low blood pressure (hypotension) in adults. Symptoms of low blood pressure include blurred or fading vision, dizziness or light-headedness, fainting, feeling sick, difficult in concentrating.

Midodrine acts on the blood vessels via the sympathetic nervous system (part of nervous system that cause increase in heart rate, blood pressure, breathing rate, and dilatation of pupil) to correct imbalances of blood distribution, such as preventing too much blood pooling in the legs when standing up which may cause low blood pressure. Your doctor may regularly monitor the blood pressure when you are lying down and when you are standing up as there may be a risk of your blood pressure rising when you lie down (Ex. at night).

JOLAVI TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe heart disease.JOLAVI TABLET should be used with caution in patient having severe kidney disease, liver problems. Consult your doctor for advice before takingJOLAVI TABLET, if you are pregnant or breast-feeding.JOLAVI TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below the age of 18 years. The most common side effects of takingJOLAVI TABLET are increased blood pressure when lying down, headache, nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, heartburn. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid gland)

Enlarged prostate

introduction:
Introduction About NORAD INJECTION

NORAD INJECTION contains Noradrenaline which belongs to the group of medicines called Adrenergic and Dopaminergic agents. It is used in emergency conditions to increase blood pressure to normal levels in adults. During NORAD INJECTION management, your doctor will monitor your blood pressure, blood volume, heart rate and the infusion site.

NORAD INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with low blood pressure caused by low blood volume. NORAD INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver, heart or kidney disease, blood clots, diabetes or over active thyroid gland.

NORAD INJECTION will be given in pregnancy only if clearly necessary as it may cause harm to unborn baby. It is not known whether NORAD INJECTION pass through the breast milk so it should be used with caution.

The safety and efficacy of NORAD INJECTION in children and adolescents under 18 years of age is not established so, contact your child’s doctor for advice. The most common side effects of NORAD INJECTION are low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, anxiety, headache, etc. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
